name: Tausendeins
description: Tausendeins (1001, Kiautschou) is a German two-player point-trick game. First to 1001 points wins. 24 cards (9 through Ace per suit). Rank: A, 10, K, Q, J, 9. Points: A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2, 9=0. No trumps initially; a player on lead with King-Queen in the same suit may declare marriage (Hochzeit) by playing one and naming that suit trump.
